finalText:
Section 5.5 is applied to the existing foundation only. Lint, typecheck and the production build all pass.

```
$ bash scripts/check.sh
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.   (oxlint, type-aware: src + scripts)
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.   (oxlint: whole project)
$ tsc --noEmit                   (clean)

$ bun run build
check-errors: all 26 ABI errors have a message.
$ tsc --noEmit
vite v6.4.5 building for production...
✓ 6425 modules transformed.
dist/assets/index-C2Ioezz6.css   13.43 kB │ gzip: 3.82 kB
✓ built in 13.07s
```
The build still prints the same third-party chunk-size notice as before, and nothing from app code. In the built CSS there is no `transition: all`, no `ease-in`, no duration over 300 ms, and no `100vh`. Every `:hover` sits inside the `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` block.

**Review of every existing component** (no `transition: all` and no `ease-in` were present in the source). Checked from code only, not on a device or with a recording.

| Before | After | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.btn` had no press state (`:active` only changed `opacity` to .76) | `transition: transform var(--dur-press) var(--ease-out)` plus `:active { transform: scale(var(--press-scale)) }` (160 ms, 0.97) | Press feedback must be a transform. The opacity change survives only under reduced motion. |
| Ungated `:hover` on `.btn-primary`, `.btn-quiet`, `.field` | Moved into `@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` | Touch fires a false hover on tap, so the hover state sticks. |
| `hover:text-ink` on two 32 px icon buttons (`AddressChip`), ungated, no press | New `.icon-btn` class with a 44 px hit area, press scale and gated hover | Tap targets need at least 44 px, and hover must be gated. |
| `hover:border-muted` on the "My retainers" row link, no press | `.pressable .pressable-row`: press scale and gated hover | Pressable rows get the same feedback as buttons (5.5). |
| Wordmark and nav links had no press feedback | `.pressable` | Every pressable element gets the press scale. Inline text links in sentences are exempt, because scaling inline text looks wrong. |
| Literal `120ms ease` in three places | `--dur-hover` (150 ms) with `--ease-hover` | One set of tokens. The hover duration moved from 120 ms to 150 ms; no color or hover duration is specified in 5.5. |
| Reduced motion set `transition-duration: 0.001ms !important` | `animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto`, and `:active` shows a color change with no scale | Spec 5.3: state changes instantly and nothing moves. A 0.001 ms duration still fires transition events. |
| Wrong-network banner popped in with no transition | `.enter-fade`: opacity only, 200 ms `--ease-out`, using `@starting-style` | A state change should not be jarring. It is interruptible, and the exit stays instant, which is faster than the enter. |
| No `-webkit-tap-highlight-color`; no `touch-action` | `html { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent }` plus `touch-action: manipulation` on controls | Removes the grey tap flash and the double-tap delay. |
| Controls selectable on long-press | `user-select: none` and no touch callout on `button`, `.btn`, `.pressable`, `.icon-btn` | Controls are not content. Body text stays selectable. |
| Input size depended on inheritance | `input, textarea, select, .field { font-size: max(16px, 1rem) }`. The Home input also gets `enterKeyHint="go"`, `autoCapitalize="none"` and `autoCorrect="off"`. | iOS zooms the page into inputs under 16 px. Zoom itself stays enabled. |
| Viewport meta without `viewport-fit=cover`; one fixed theme | `viewport-fit=cover, interactive-widget=resizes-content`, `color-scheme`, and a `theme-color` for each scheme matching `--paper` | `env(safe-area-inset-*)` is 0 without `viewport-fit=cover`. The status bar follows the scheme. |
| Header, main, banner and config page used `px-4` with no safe-area padding | `.shell-x`, `.shell-top` and `.shell-bottom`, which use `env(safe-area-inset-*)` | Content stays clear of the notch and the home indicator. |
| No `-webkit-text-size-adjust` | `100%` on `html` | No font inflation in landscape. |

**What I added**
- **Tokens in `src/index.css`:** `--ease-out`, `--ease-in-out`, `--ease-hover`, `--ease-linear`, `--dur-press` (160 ms), `--dur-hover`, `--dur-popover`, `--dur-dialog`, `--dur-enter`, `--dur-exit`, `--dur-stamp` (300 ms) and `--press-scale`.
- **Unused tokens:** `--ease-in-out`, `--ease-linear`, `--dur-popover`, `--dur-dialog`, `--dur-exit` and `--dur-stamp` have no consumers yet. They are there for the dialogs, the fuse and the "Paid" stamp.
- **Files changed:** `src/index.css`, `index.html`, `tailwind.config.js`, `AddressChip.tsx`, `AppShell.tsx`, `NetworkBanner.tsx`, `ConfigErrorPage.tsx`, `MyRetainers.tsx` and `Home.tsx`.
- **Tailwind backstop:** I set `future.hoverOnlyWhenSupported` in `tailwind.config.js`. It gates any Tailwind `hover:` utility behind `(hover: hover)`, but not behind `(pointer: fine)`. No such utility remains in the source.

**Verdict:** Approve. After the fixes there are no feel-breaking regressions. All remaining transitions are `transform`, `opacity` or a color, and they are interruptible CSS transitions rather than keyframes.

**Left alone**
- **Studio watermark in `main.tsx`:** it uses a backdrop blur and a shadow, but it is scaffold code and not part of the product UI.
- **Wallet modal:** ConnectKit's own motion is unchanged.
- **Count text:** the claim countdown text and the 1-second tick animate nothing.
- **Copy button:** the swap from the copy icon to the check icon is instant by design.

**Needs a real phone, which I could not verify:** the tap highlight, the safe-area insets and `theme-color`, the iOS input zoom, and sticky hover on touch.

**Proposals for later, with no dependency added now**
- **Sonner:** `<Toaster />` is already mounted but unused. When transaction toasts arrive it will need theming to match the square 0-radius panels, since its defaults are rounded with a shadow.
- **base-ui:** the confirmation dialogs in the next screens would be the place to add it, rather than hand-rolling them. Tell me whether to add it then.

I did not touch `contracts/`, `foundry.toml`, `remappings.txt`, `deployments/`, `src/tracing.ts`, `src/console-capture.ts`, `README.md` or `AGENTS.md`, and I wrote no mainnet config.
